<!-- stormworks-research-gap:mechanics:diesel-engines -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/mechanics/diesel-engines).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> The small engine accepts throttle from 0 to 1. Its starter description says electrical power increases engine RPS for startup. Coolant has separate cold return and hot output ports. The small and large definitions set engine_max_force to 20000 and 200000 respectively, but this field does not establish measured power or torque.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/4/body`

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> Fuel consumption, thermal efficiency, overheating thresholds, starter load and torque curves are not recovered here.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/4/limitations/2`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Diesel engine connections and startup: resolve missing mechanics
